Her hair is scraped back and tucked under a bald cap, and a photographer instructs her to close her eyes and open her mouth, then open her eyes and close her mouth, and so on. articles.title: Can Democrats Flip the House and Senate? The Lever's David Sirota on Midterm Races to Watch
articles.dek: The midterm elections are in less than three weeks, on November 3. With Republican majorities in both chambers of Congress on the line, the Trump administration has thrown its time and resources into holding rallies in newly competitive states. We take a look at key Senate races in Georgia, Texas, Michigan and Maine with The Lever ’s David Sirota. Ultimately, says Sirota, election results will hinge on voter turnout. “Will there be that surge of turnout based on how unpopular Trump is and how bad the affordability crisis is?” And, if they win, can Democrats then “deliver” on their promises?
